# Infinite numbers

A duration of .inf, an offset of .nan and a duration of 1e400, too large to be finite, fail the node schema, so all three descriptions are ignored.

So do a duration written as a decimal integer of 5,000 digits or a hex integer of 300 digits, and a sync entry whose "at" is an integer of 401 digits: each is too large to be finite. The reference description is valid, so a range on it matches; its alternate is ignored, so a range on that is not checked.
